body:
Part 1 of same-project Rust `extract` (D-185): the scoped resolver the command (task:4375a3b1075dced2) calls to rewrite references. Rust `extract` stays refused after this task; the work is tested on its own in `language::rust_refs`. Follow the plan in note 16.

**Problem.** `language::rust_refs` is built for test reach and matches too much on purpose: `scan` gives only a line per mention, a field access counts as a path, there are no local bindings, and `Refs::path` falls back to any crate item with the same last name. That must stay as it is for `graph`, but cannot drive rewriting.

**Do.**
- Mention spans: `scan` records each mention's byte range; add a field mention (`x.make`, no call). `graph` reach does not change.
- Lexical scopes: exclude `let` bindings (from the end of the pattern to the end of the block), closure, `match`, `if let`/`while let`/`for` and parameter bindings (including destructured), local `fn`/`const`/`static`/type declarations, struct-literal field names, and macros.
- `Refs::resolve_exact`: paths only, one target, no fallback or leaf match, so `vendor::make` and `std::collections::HashMap` resolve to nothing. It says how the name was reached (own item, `use` binding with its local name, or qualified/`self::`/`super::`/`crate::` path).
- `rewrite_sites` and `use_sites`: every unshadowed mention of an item, and every `use` tree site including aliases and group members.
- Add new symbols before `mod tests` and submit in small patches. No unused imports or dead items: helpers the command does not call yet are reached by tests; `check --warnings` stays clean.

**Tests.** A local, field, method call and closure sharing an item's name give no site; a `match` binding and destructured parameter give none; `vendor::make` and `std::collections::HashMap` don't resolve to crate items; a real call before a shadowing `let`, and after an inner block that shadowed it, give sites; an import-bound name and an `as` alias are reported; `graph` reach and the existing `rust_refs` tests are unchanged.

**Out of scope.** The command, transaction, errors, D-185 and docs (task:4375a3b1075dced2); impls and test modules; import carrying; namespaces.
title: extract: Rust resolver on rust_refs
